site.footer: Data and tools, not advice. Crypto-assets can lose all their value.

legal.placeholder: This page is published in full before {product} opens. Until then the service is not available and collects nothing.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: {product} is software for recording and visualising a plan you design.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: {product} collects only what the service you ask for needs, and never sells or shares it for advertising.

risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.lead: {product} is software for a plan you design. It gives no financial, investment, or tax advice; the coins, amounts, and days in a plan are the ones you set. Most crypto-assets are highly volatile; you could lose all the money you put in. Use only money you will not need for years.

dca.title: What a plan does and does not do
dca.p1: With a plan, you buy a set amount on a set schedule, so no single day's price decides what you pay on average. {product} records each purchase with its date, amount, and units, and shows where you are in the plan.
dca.p2: A plan does not limit how far a price can fall, does not make a better outcome more likely, and does not protect what you spend. If prices fall and stay low, a plan can end with less than it cost.

falls.title: Falls from a high
falls.p1: Each row below is one fall of one coin, from a cycle high to the lowest price after it. The deepest falls so far are not a limit: a coin can fall further, to zero.

custody.title: Custody and counterparties
custody.p1: {product} never holds your money or your coins. You buy and keep coins with a provider you choose, or in a wallet of your own.
custody.p2: A provider can fail, be hacked, or stop withdrawals, with its customers' coins inside. If you keep coins yourself and lose the seed phrase, nobody can restore them.

status.title: No supervisor and no compensation scheme
status.p1: {product} is not registered with or supervised by any financial supervisor, and no investor-compensation or deposit-protection scheme covers crypto-assets.

tax.title: Tax
tax.p1: Selling, swapping, or spending coins can mean tax to pay, and each country's rules differ and change. {product} shows each country's holding rules with their sources. Where your plan has a holding rule, it shows the date each purchase passes it. This is information, not tax advice. A tax adviser or your tax authority can tell you what applies to you.

scams.title: Scams
scams.p1: {product} never offers you an investment and never asks for your seed phrase, an exchange's API key or login, or for coins or money to buy them. A message that does is not from {product}, whoever it seems to come from.
scams.p2: Signs of a scam: a promise that money will grow fast with little risk, a stranger who turns the talk to investing, or any request for your seed phrase or for an exchange's API key or login.

register.title: Check a provider
register.p1: ESMA keeps a public register of the providers authorised under MiCA: <link>{label}</link>. Check any provider there before sending money. {product} is not a provider and is not listed.

adviser.title: Finding an adviser
adviser.p1: For advice on your own situation, look for a financial adviser registered with your country's supervisor. Check them on its register before you pay or sign anything. Ask how they are paid: an adviser paid by the products they sell has a reason to sell them.

warnings.title: Official warnings
warnings.p1: Supervisors publish their own information on the risks of crypto-assets:

cookies.title: Cookie-free statement
cookies.lead: {product} sets no advertising or analytics cookies, loads no third-party scripts, and does no fingerprinting.
cookies.storesOffline: Your browser keeps your plan, your entries, and the prices fetched for your coins on this device, so the app works offline. It keeps the app's files, so the app opens offline. It keeps the pages you opened for up to 7 days and the latest price data for 24 hours, so they show offline. It keeps the date each copy was saved, so copies past their limit are cleared.
cookies.storesSettings: Your browser also keeps your display settings (theme, reduced motion, chart range, and the Log's view), so they stay as you chose them. It keeps the dates of your last JSON backup and your last change, so the app can remind you to export a copy. It keeps the banners you dismissed or that showed once, so they stay hidden. It keeps the date of your last annual review, so the next review shows when it is due.
cookies.storesRecords: Your browser keeps a record of the entries you deleted on this device, so an import with Add missing entries only cannot bring them back. It keeps the plan and entries that Replace everything removed, in full and marked as deleted, so that import cannot bring the entries back either. These records stay until you choose Delete everything in Settings or clear this site's data in your browser.
cookies.storesSync: It keeps a random identifier for this device, so your changes apply in the order you made them. It does not leave this browser: no request and no backup carries it. It keeps a copy of each change to your plan and entries, for syncing between devices, which the app does not offer. It keeps any stored data that failed its check when read, set aside instead of deleted, so a failed check erases nothing. Delete everything in Settings clears these too.
cookies.storesTab: Your browser keeps form drafts until the tab closes, so what you typed comes back when you return to the form. After an update, if part of the app fails to load, the tab keeps a short note until it closes, so it reloads only once.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: The full contact details and the legal notice are published before {product} opens.
contact.security: Report a security issue to the address in security.txt. You get an acknowledgement within 72 hours. Good-faith research does not lead to legal action when it accesses no data beyond what proves the issue, does not disrupt the service, and is not made public before a fix. Credit on request.
